Your words. Your website.

Create & publish

Write a story, share a Field Note or add a travel fact. You control what goes online.

Sign in to open your publishing desk.

Your entries

Drafts stay private. Published entries are visible on your website.

Only name a place you are ready to share publicly.

Formatting help

Leave an empty line between paragraphs. Start a heading with ##. Use **bold words**, - for list items, or [link text](https://example.com). HTML is treated as text.

Photographs

Add up to 12 photos. They are resized on your device before upload; original files and location metadata are not uploaded. The first photo is your cover.

Film & sources Optional

Films open only when a visitor chooses to watch. Large video files are not uploaded here.

You can save unfinished text as a private draft. Complete the title, introduction and story before previewing and publishing.

Restore a downloaded backup

Restores a new private copy in this form. Nothing is saved or published until you choose to do so.

Publishing does not send a newsletter. Use Postcards to manage emails separately.
